open.text: [US4] [B] Point the bot's playground button at the testnet host — the code is in and the host answers, but `FLEET_TESTNET_URL` is unset where the bot runs, so there is no door yet. specs.title: Trade on any chain, burn one token

phases.name: One account address on every chain
Paste a token, trade it where it lives
Orders, alerts and positions on every chain

open.text: [L] Build reads, session chain, order runner, watcher and risk watch per enabled chain from that list; with `BOT_CHAINS=4663` the full bot suite passes unchanged
[L] Swap encoding chosen by chain: the 4663 variant with `minHopPriceX36`, the standard v4 one elsewhere, each pinned by a test
[L] Session factory on a Base fork through the deterministic deployer; account n has the same address as on 4663
[L] Sessions page chain picker: every read, button and transaction follows the picked chain, named in words
[L] Resolve a pasted address or one-tap link to its chain by code and symbol; two matches ask, Robinhood Chain first
[L] Base buys and sells on a fork through the bot, every card and line naming its chain
[L] Order runner per chain; a Base stop loss fires once at its level in a Base fork test
[L] Watcher and risk watch for Base; positions across chains in one card
[L] Fee accrual on Base and the sweep home through Relay to the 4663 buyback, quote checked against the ask; a failed sweep leaves the ETH where it was
[L] Holders line and holder discount read $CHIT on 4663 only
[B] Deploy the factory on Base, then the bot with `BOT_CHAINS=4663,8453`, after the gates
